candidate_analysis.method: maximal exact-zero runs plus opposite-sign samples; result-blind time/density filter; linear interpolation only

claim_scope: Discovery-grid topology screening only; never a continuum fold claim

budget_diagnostics.affine_line_certificate: weights are affine in theta; endpoint unit sums and componentwise nonnegativity imply the same for every theta in [0,1]

initial_reconstruction.tolerance_rule: absolute moment error <= one half of the corresponding cell width
